comment: The conformance model covers technical and semantic conformance thoroughly but does not test governance. A component can pass every technical test while having no designated holder, no independently published performance, no transfer plan and no dispute route - which are the failure modes that actually end programmes.

public.text: The conformance model covers technical and semantic conformance thoroughly but does not test governance. A component can pass every technical test while having no designated holder, no independently published performance, no transfer plan and no dispute route - which are the failure modes that actually end programmes.
public.suggestedRevision: Add governance conformance as a distinct test level with objectively checkable criteria: a designated operator with defined mandate and term; an approved multi-year plan; performance published by an independent party; a maintained transfer dossier and an exercised transfer plan; a functioning dispute route; and a stated revision moment. Countries could then report governance conformance alongside technical conformance, since it is governance conformance that determines whether a capability survives a change of political attention.
